text:
Jess Kim: Quick nudge — planning to cut v0.9.1 tomorrow 3pm PT. We need version bumps across API, runtime, console, and SDKs. Please confirm your PRs are green.

Ranjit Singh: On runtime side I'll open the bump PR today. Will need a green perf test before cutoff.

Maya Patel: Console already has a draft changelog. I can finalize after runtime bump lands.

Omar Diaz: SDKs: will need regen after API proto changes. @SDK-regen-bot can you queue the regen once API PR merges?

SDK-regen-bot: queued SDK regen for main -> will post PRs when artifacts are available.

Jess Kim: Cutoff rules: no feature changes after cutoff, only bugfix/security. Tagging scheme: v0.9.1. If you have any docs or changelog bullets, add them before cutoff. :memo:

Ranjit Singh: Runtime note: bump includes quant backend tweak; this is a minor bump on runtime, but check that the API surface remains compatible. Running perf tests now.

Maya Patel: Quick question — branch naming convention for the release?

Jess Kim: release/v0.9.1 — please branch from main. We'll fast-forward main after the cut.

Omar Diaz: For SDKs, checklist I'm going to follow: update package.json versions, regenerate clients, update changelog snippets, run unit + integration tests. Will open a meta PR listing SDK PRs.

Jess Kim: Release checklist (short):
- bump versions in api/runtime/console
- regen & publish SDKs (or open PRs)
- merge changelogs into docs/release-notes
- create release tag v0.9.1 and draft release notes
- run staging canary and smoke tests

Ranjit Singh: Perf tests queued, ETA ~2h. If perf regresses >5% we may hold the runtime bump. I'll post results here.

Maya Patel: @Jess can you ping @Dave for a quick console review when the runtime PR lands? He's the last approver for UI changes.

Jess Kim: ping @Dave for console review :point_up:

CI-bot: release branch created: release/v0.9.1 by Jess Kim

Omar Diaz: Note: SDK regen may surface minor TS typing changes. We'll try to keep changes minimal but will call out breaking items in the changelog.

Ranjit Singh: Also remember to update the model-compat matrix in docs if anything changed in the runtime semantics.

Maya Patel: I'll own the release notes once all PRs are merged. Please add 1-2 bullet points per PR (what changed, impact).

Jess Kim: Thanks — I'll assemble the release PR after merges and aim to cut at 3pm PT. If anything blocks, post here ASAP. :raised_hands:

Omar Diaz: ACK, will post SDK PR links when ready.

Ranjit Singh: Perf tests: all green (no regression). Marking runtime PR ready for review.

Maya Patel: Console review passed, addressed two comments.

Jess Kim: Great. Small reminder: after tag, someone needs to run `scripts/release_notes.sh v0.9.1` and upload release assets. I'll do that if no one else volunteers.

Omar Diaz: :thumbsup: I'll watch SDK publish steps and confirm package versions.

Jess Kim: Final call — cutting at 3pm PT. If you want to opt out of a change for this cut, say so now.

Ranjit Singh: All good from runtime side.

Maya Patel: All set.

Omar Diaz: SDK PRs open: #312, #313 (client regen). Adding changelog bullets now.

Jess Kim: Thanks team — I'll post the final release link once done.

CI-bot: release v0.9.1 tagged by Jess Kim — draft notes created.
